title: Delete my personal data (GDPR / CCPA)
summary: Exercise the right to erasure: ask a controller to delete your personal data and confirm.
goal_default: Please erase my personal data, stop processing it, and confirm completion in writing.

fields.name: data_ref
fields.label: Account email or identifier the data is under

rights.claim: You have a right to erasure of your personal data ('right to be forgotten').
You can request deletion of personal information a business has collected about you.
rights.basis: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), right to delete.

rights.claim: The controller must respond within the statutory window (e.g. one month under GDPR).

ladder: Privacy request to the DPO / privacy team
Supervisory authority (DPA) or state Attorney General complaint if ignored

artifact.subject: Request to delete my personal data

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
